ranking.name: Water in the topsoil
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water in the topsoil in the Mediterranean changed by −0.95 kg/m² per decade (95% confidence interval −1.20 to −0.69), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is a decrease of about 2.35 kg/m².

ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in the Mediterranean changed by +0.30 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.17 to +0.42), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.73 °C.

ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in the Mediterranean shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.12): the estimate is +0.014 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.004 to +0.032). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.

ranking.name: Water running off the surface
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water running off the surface in the Mediterranean shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.36): the estimate is −0.0037 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.0109 to +0.0039). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.

ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in the Mediterranean shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.54): the estimate is −0.016 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.071 to +0.037). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
